scenarios.title: Combat damage to a player from a creature with toxic gives poison counters

setup.notes: Nettling Host is a 3/3 with toxic 2. It has been under A's control since earlier turns. B holds Holy Day {W} and has one Plains. Players start with 0 poison counters.

decisions: A moves to combat and declares Nettling Host as an attacker.
B declares no blockers and casts nothing. Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Nettling Host deals 3 combat damage to B: B is at 17 and gets 2 poison counters.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Nettling Host.
variants.expected: Nettling Host deals its damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies; Host takes 2 damage and survives. B is at 20 with 0 poison counters.

variants.label: prevented
variants.delta: B casts Holy Day after attackers are declared, tapping Plains.
variants.expected: All combat damage is prevented. B is at 20 with 0 poison counters.
